clinicalSignoff: Required before a clinical-impact manifest can pass. A missing name is a failure.
breakGlass: A break-glass review needs a reason, a scope, an expiry, and a named approver. None is recorded here.
changeControl: A change records a version, a reason, and an author role.
surveillance: A release records what will be watched and which role owns that watch. No completed surveillance study is claimed.

sampleManifest.intendedUse: Check that a release gate manifest is complete before a documentation release is accepted.
sampleManifest.rollback: Remove the gate checker and this manifest.
sampleManifest.audit: The checker records the missing field in its test output.

changeControl.reason: Phase 00 requires a release gate that rejects an incomplete manifest.

surveillance.watch: Re-run the gate checker when a feature manifest changes.
